name: led-0805-violet-415
description: TUOZHAN P2-0805UVTCS2-0.8T 0805 violet LED, 410-420 nm peak (13 nm FWHM), 20 mA test / 30 mA max, Vf 2.8-3.4 V (3.0 typ), 90 mW, 120 deg, 10-50 mcd (LCSC C2827270). The violet primary below the whites' 450 nm pump; run on its own 20 mA regulator string

vf_trim.description: forward-voltage offset in volts (bin spread); the series source V<ref>_trim also measures the LED current

metadata.rotation_note: JLCPCB's reel orientation is 180 degrees from this footprint (their preview on the mug order, 2026-09-08, showed it backwards at offset 0). With 180 the cathode lands on the +x pad. The datasheet's own polarity marks remain ambiguous: confirm with a meter on the first board.
